question: Toshikazu Yamanishi set a new world record in which event in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is 2__**0 km race walk**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On 16 February 2025, Toshikazu Yamanishi set a new world record at the Japanese 20km Race Walking Championships in Kobe.
 
• He completed the race in 1 hour, 16 minutes, and 10 seconds, breaking the previous record by 26 seconds.
 
• Previous Record: 1:16:36, set by fellow Japanese athlete Yusuke Suzuki in 2015.
 
• Significant Achievement: This victory marked Yamanishi's third title in the event and secured his place in the Japanese team for the World Athletics Championships in Tokyo.
 
• Technique: Yamanishi is noted for maintaining high speeds while strictly adhering to the technical requirements of race walking, ensuring one foot is always in contact with the ground.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Toshikazu Yamanishi’s Career Profile:**

 
 
• **Yamanishi** is a **two-time World Champion** in the **20 km race walk**, having won gold medals at the **2019 World Athletics Championships** in **Doha** and the **2022 World Athletics Championships** in **Eugene**.
 
• He also secured a **Bronze Medal** at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** (held in **2021**) in the **20 km** event, demonstrating consistent excellence on the global stage.
 
• **Japan’s Dominance in Race Walking:**
 
 
• In recent years, **Japan** has become a global powerhouse in race walking, producing several world-class athletes like **Koki Ikeda** and **Yusuke Suzuki**.
 
• The infrastructure and coaching programs in **Japan** specifically target the technical nuances of the sport, leading to multiple records and podium finishes in **Asian Games** and **Olympic** competitions.
 
 
 

 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 
• **Technical Rules of Race Walking:**

 
 
• Athletes can be disqualified if they lose contact with the ground (**lifting**) or fail to keep the knee straight (**creeping**). These rules are strictly monitored by **World Athletics** judges using yellow paddles and red cards.
 
• The **10 km race walk** world record requires formal ratification by **World Athletics**, involving drug testing and course measurement certification.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Year 2025:**
 
 
• Setting a world record in **February 2025** is crucial for **Yamanishi** as it sets the momentum for the **2025 World Athletics Championships** scheduled to be held in **Tokyo** in **September**.
 
• This performance marks one of the earliest major world records broken in the **2025** athletics season.
